spans.s: पव (I) m. 1. Wind; 2. purification.
पव (II) n. Cow-dung.
पवन (I) m. Air, wind, R.i.42, ii.13, Megh.i.8, 14, Bg.x.31.
पवन (II) n. 1. Purifiction; 2. winnowing; 3. a sieve, a strainer; 4. water; 5. a potter’s kiln.
पावन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Purifying, freeing from sin, sanctifying, R.xv.101, xix.53, Bg.xviii.5; 2. holy, pure, K.S.v.17.
पावन (II) m. 1. Fire; 2. incense; 3. an epithet of Vyāsa; 4. a siddha.
पावन (III) n. 1. Purifying, purification; 2. penance; 3. cow-dung; 4. water.
पवन-अशन, -भुज् m. a serpent.
पवन-अशन, -भुज् m. a serpent.
पवन-आत्मज m. 1. fire; 2. an epithet of Hanūmat; 3. of Bhīma.
पवन-आश m. a serpent, a snake.
पवन-आश˚नाश m. 1. an epithet of Garuḍa; 2. a peacock.
पवन-तनय, -सुत m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma.
पवन-तनय, -सुत m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma.
पवन-व्याधि m. 1. an epithet of Uddhava, a friend and counsellor of Kṛṣṇa, प्रापयन् पवनव्याधोर्गिरमुत्तरपक्षताम् Sis.ii.15; 2. rheumatism.
पवमान m. 1. Air, wind; 2. the sacred fire called Gārhapatya.
पवाका f. A whirlwind, a hurricane.
पावक m. 1. Fire, पावकस्य महिमा स गण्यते कक्षवज्ज्वलति सागरेऽपि यः R.xi.75; 2. Agni or the deity presiding over fire; 3. a flash of lightning; 4. the number ‘three.’
पवि m. The thunderbolt of Indra.
पवित (I) a. (f. ता) Purified.
पवित (II) n. Black pepper.
पवित (I) a. (f. ता) Purified.
पवित्र (I) a. (f. त्रा) 1. Holy, sacred, sanctified, R.ii.2; 2. pure; 3. purified by the performance of religious rites.

पवित्र (II) n. 1. A couple of kuśa blades used in sprinkling ghee; 2. a ring of kuśa worn on the fourth finger on certain occasions, M.iii.235; 3. the sacred cord worn by the members of the first three Hindu castes; 4. rain; 5. copper; 6. water; 7. rubbing, cleansing; 8. a vessel in which the arghya is presented; 9. clarified butter; 10. honey.
पवित्र (I) a. (f. त्रा) 1. Holy, sacred, sanctified, R.ii.2; 2. pure; 3. purified by the performance of religious rites.
पवित्र-आरोपण, -आरोहण n. investiture with the sacred cord.
पवित्र-आरोपण, -आरोहण n. investiture with the sacred cord.
पवित्र-पाणि a. holding darbha grass in the hand.
पवित्र-धान्य n. barley.
पवित्रक n. Thread of which nets are made.
पावक-आत्मज m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. name of a sage.
पावकि m. An epithet of Kārtikeya.
पावन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Purifying, freeing from sin, sanctifying, R.xv.101, xix.53, Bg.xviii.5; 2. holy, pure, K.S.v.17.
पावनी f. 1. The holy basil; 2. a cow; 3. the river Ganges.
पावन-ध्वनि m. a conch shell.
पावमानी f. An epithet of particular Vedic hymns.
पावर m. 1. The side of a die which is marked with two points; 2. a particular throw of the die, पावरपतनाच्च शोषितशरीरः Mrich.ii.
